mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS eval_report ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL UNIQUE, ts VARCHAR(32),columns_json JSONB NOT NULL,rows_json JSONB NOT NULL, size_bytes BIGINT DEFAULT 0,created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now())
COMMENT ON TABLE eval_report IS '离线评估与分析报表的结构化存储'
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_eval_report_cat_ts ON eval_report (category,ts DESC)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_report(category,name,ts,columns_json,rows_json,size_bytes) VALUES(#{report.category},#{report.name},#{report.ts},#{report.columnsJson}::jsonb,#{report.rowsJson}::jsonb,#{report.sizeBytes}) ON CONFLICT(name) DO NOTHING
